description: Search live Carousell Hong Kong listings by keyword or category, fetch detail pages, or pull a seller profile and inventory. Hong Kong only; no account or API key required.

category.description: Top-level category. The actor resolves the correct market-specific collection ID and URL.
category.title: Category (mode=category)

condition.description: Server-side layered condition filter. Carousell uses codes 3, 4, 7, 5 and 6 for these labels.
condition.title: Condition

country.description: Verified market: hong_kong only. Other Carousell markets are blocked or unreliable from Apify cloud and are not offered.
country.title: Market

includeDetails.description: Fetch and merge full detail pages for search, category or seller results. Adds one request per listing.
includeDetails.title: Fetch detail pages

listingUrls.description: Carousell /p/ listing URLs or bare listing IDs. Bare IDs use Hong Kong. URLs from unsupported markets are skipped.

url.description: Carousell /p/ listing URL or bare listing ID.
url.title: Listing URL

listingUrls.title: Listing URLs or IDs (mode=listingDetails)

maxDetailItems.description: Cap on detail-page requests when includeDetails is enabled (or in listingDetails mode).
maxDetailItems.title: Maximum detail pages

maxItems.description: Overall record cap. Carousell returns at most 48 listings per query, so larger values cannot exceed that first-page limit.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

mode.description: Search listings, browse one category, fetch listing detail URLs, or pull a seller profile with its listings.
mode.title: Mode

postedWithinDays.description: Client-side filter over the first page. Listings without a visible creation timestamp are excluded when this is set.
postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)

priceMax.description: Maximum price in the market's local currency (server-side).
priceMax.title: Maximum price

priceMin.description: Minimum price in the market's local currency (server-side).
priceMin.title: Minimum price

queries.description: One or more keywords (mode=search). Each query returns Carousell's first page of up to 48 listings per market.
queries.title: Search queries

sellerUsernames.description: Carousell usernames to fetch. Each seller returns profile fields plus the first page of their listings.
sellerUsernames.title: Seller usernames (mode=seller)

sortBy.description: Server-side sort. Best match is Carousell's default and sends no sort parameter.
sortBy.title: Sort by

title: Carousell Marketplace Listing Search (Hong Kong) Input
